environment: scripts/e2e.ps1 isolated preview API/World/Vite; Playwright Chromium
test: event Q&A and polls stay localized for an English host and attendee
assertions: host and attendee explicitly enable event tools after joining with the default hidden state
the host starts an event and the attendee sees the English preview-retention notice
an English attendee submits a question, the host replies, and the answer reaches the attendee
the host starts and closes an English poll, the attendee vote synchronizes, and the option becomes disabled
limitations: This covers the English preview event Q&A and poll flow, not every event screen.
No real SSO accounts, physical devices, or production event persistence were used.
